description: Deterministic database, concurrency, API, security, and secrets verification gates

verification_details.tenant_isolation: Verified cross-tenant read and write attempts return HTTP 404/400; zero data leakage across isolated tenant boundaries.
verification_details.unsafe_uploads: Verified directory traversal paths (../../) are stripped and sanitized by storage layer.
verification_details.prompt_injection: Adversarial override payloads inside source documents do not bypass schemas and cannot mutate ledger balances.
verification_details.stale_actions: Actions cannot be executed twice; cancelled actions cannot be executed; state transitions strictly enforced.
verification_details.gateway_tampering: SSLCommerz tampered amount callbacks rejected with HTTP 400; duplicate callbacks handled idempotently.
verification_details.secrets_scan: 172 tracked repository files scanned with zero private keys or credentials detected.
